Each stone boasts a distinct color and texture, inviting collectors and enthusiasts alike to appreciate their unique beauty. This striking natural specimen shadow box displays an authentic polished geode agate slice suspended within a multi-tiered mat presentation. The cross-section features prominent concentric banding in deep amber, rich brown, and smoky translucent tones surrounding a crystalline quartz druzy center. Encased in a dark wood-finish square shadowbox frame with interior depth, the piece combines natural geological history with refined contemporary organic modern interior decor.
Genuine cut and polished natural agate cross-section with crystal quartz center
Recessed double matting provides clean dimensional shadow box presentation
Dust backing paper marked Made in the USA with attached sawtooth hanging hardware
Frame measures approximately 13.25" x 13.25" with a 1.5" profile depth
Condition:
Very good pre-owned condition. The agate specimen is fully intact with natural crystalline formations and polished face. The glass glazing is clean and clear. The frame shows light, minor cosmetic surface wear along the edges and corners consistent with gentle display. Backing paper is intact with an attached sawtooth hanger ready for hanging.
POLICIES and Seller Info
How to reach us-
Per the policies of our selling location, we do not remove unpaid items or cancel bids. Thank you for understanding!
Sending a message via shopgoodwill.com message is the only way to reach us and receive a response. Your concerns are very important to us, but we do not have a business phone on site. Calls to the home office cannot be transferred to us, so if you call and leave a message, you are guaranteed NOT to receive a response and we don't want that! Customer services messages are checked throughout the day, Monday through Friday (excluding holidays), between the hours of 9am and 4pm eastern time.
Domestic Shipping-
Items with a Fixed/Flat shipping fee (rather than calculated) will ship the cheapest possible way, FedEx shipping is not guaranteed on items with a fixed shipping cost. FedEx does not ship to P.O. boxes or APO/FPO addresses. Please enter an address that we can ship to at check out.
Your package will be insured, regardless of mail class or carrier, however, insurance DOES NOT cover theft after delivery. Porch piracy is very common so we strongly suggest that you use your DAYTIME address you will be available to receive your package. If you require a specific carrier, signature confirmation, or have a special packing/handling request, please make your needs known by clicking Contact Seller prior to making payment so that we can add applicable fees for service(s) requested. We have accounts with FedEx and USPS only.
Handling-
Items like instruments, artwork, delicate collectibles, stereo receivers, and sewing machines require additional packing materials and labor to pack them safely. For this reason, handling fees are higher on specialty items.
Handling fees cap at $15 on combined orders. So if you combine 10 items with a $2 each handling fee, the system will automatically discount your shipping price and your handling would be $15 rather than $20. (This applies to items combined from Chattanooga Area Goodwill only).
General Disclaimers-
All items are donated and in used condition unless otherwise specified. Please manage your expectations accordingly.
Colors may vary depending on the settings of your monitor. Items are measured by hand, and are may vary by 1-3cm.
All items have potentially been exposed to pets and/or other allergens. Returns are not authorized for odors, ever, under any circumstance. If you are sensitive to allergens and/or odors, we recommend that you not purchase pre-owned items.
We typically do not authorize returns, so it is VERY important that you read the full description, carefully view all photos, and ask any questions you may have PRIOR to placing bids. Pictures are considered a part of the item description. Any item returned without prior authorization from the seller will be considered a donation and re-sold.
Special Disclaimers (
whenever applicable
)-
Our Presidium Gem Tester is able to identify the gemstone family or families based on the hardness of the tested gem. We are not certified gemologists, so we are not always able to determine the specific gemstone(s) present, differentiate between certain stones, or confirm the device's findings.
Most of the world's pearls are cultured. The ability to differentiate between cultured, freshwater, and natural (ocean) pearls is beyond the scope of our equipment.
Unless otherwise stated above, all marked metals are tested by our Thermo Scientific Niton DXL Precious Metal Analyzer. Photos will be provided in listing of results. If not, a precious metal it will be listed and Gold/Silver Tone or plated.
Some listings may contain a mixture of fine jewelry AND costume jewelry. Please read full description to understand what you are buying. Items described as costume jewelry are presumed to not include precious metals, regardless of any markings you may see in photos.
Local Pick Up-
We do not have local pickup. All items will be shipped.  If you'd like to have it shipped to your place of business instead of a residential address. Please contact us with any shipping questions.
International Shipping-
INTERNATIONAL BUYERS' OUTSIDE OF THE USA AND CANADA are not eligible for any shipping discounts including flat rate or penny shipping. Contact us via Shopgoodwill.com message for an estimate prior to bidding on any items with discounted shipping.
